title: Cisco ThousandEyes operations
description: Recreate the ThousandEyes default alert rules in Splunk: packet loss, HTTP availability, DNS errors, BGP reachability, agent-to-agent loss for WAN sites, latency, path changes, and the health of your own agents.

requiredData.notes: Enable the Tests Stream metrics input and the Event input in ta_cisco_thousandeyes. Turn on network measurements and 'Collect BGP data' on layered HTTP tests; run DNS as standalone tests. No Internet Insights package needed.

industrySources.control: Default alert rules: Network (loss >= 10%), HTTP (any error), DNS Server (error present), BGP (reachability < 100%), Agent to Agent (loss >= 10%)
Layered HTTP + agent-to-server + BGP tests, standalone DNS, agent-to-agent for WAN sites

curationNotes: UC-5.9.2 alerts on avg_loss > 0.5 (0.5 percent); the ThousandEyes Default Network Alert Rule 2.0 is packet loss >= 10 percent. Align the threshold in the sidecar before publishing or it pages on noise.
UC-5.9.22 lists UC-5.9.18 (Internet Insights, a separate TE-INSIGHTS licence) as a prerequisite; relax that prerequisite before publishing.
Skips UC-5.9.18 Internet Insights outages and SIP / MOS / FTP / page-load tests. No catalogue twin exists for the Default SSL Certificate Expiry Rule 2.0.
